title: Host-Aware Web Crawling for LLM Pretraining Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.13321v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web crawling is a major source of large language model (LLM) pretraining data, yet data-selection pipelines discard a large share of crawled pages. We investigate how a crawler should allocate its budget across and within hosts to collect more high-quality pretraining data. Combining document-level quality classifier scores, web-graph centrality metrics, and Common Crawl's per-host crawl coverage, we find that roughly half of the variation in classifier scores occurs between hosts. In the crawls we analyze, a few pages from a host also provide a useful estimate of the quality of its remaining pages. Common Crawl uses harmonic centrality, a graph centrality metric, to guide its crawl allocation. In our simulations, using centrality to choose which hosts to crawl yields limited gains over random ordering and performs worse for some classifiers. translated_title: 面向大语言模型预训练数据的感知主机网络爬取方法
translated_abstract: 网络爬取是大语言模型（LLM）预训练数据的主要来源，然而数据筛选流程会丢弃大量已爬取的页面。我们研究了爬虫应如何在主机之间以及主机内部分配其抓取预算，以收集更多高质量的预训练数据。通过结合文档级质量分类器得分、网络图中心性指标以及Common Crawl的按主机爬取覆盖率，我们发现分类器得分中大约一半的变异发生在主机之间。在我们分析的爬取数据中，来自某个主机的少量页面也能对其剩余页面的质量提供有用的估计。Common Crawl使用调和中心性（一种图中心性指标）来指导其爬取分配。在我们的模拟中，使用中心性来选择要爬取哪些主机相比随机排序收益有限，且在某些分类器上表现更差。对于决定每个主机的爬取深度，采样少量页面然后从主机获取更多……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现页面质量约一半的差异源于主机层面，且少量采样页面即可有效估计主机质量，因此基于主机感知的爬虫预算分配策略比图中心性方法更适合收集高质量LLM预训练数据。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that roughly half of page quality variation occurs between hosts and that sampling a few pages per host provides a useful quality estimate, showing that host-aware crawl budget allocation outperforms graph centrality methods like harmonic centrality for collecting high-quality LLM pretraining data.
